collection_notes: The M0.1 correction, M0.2 engineered-workflow clarification, and this registry bootstrap are self-referential maintenance work and do not count toward the ten real-task samples.

Each future sample records coordination_mode, shared_write_set_policy, tool_dispositions, context_adapter, and skill_lifecycle_action; none/not_applicable values are valid and must not trigger unnecessary agents or tools.

Deferred does not mean the pilot executed, completed, or demonstrated benefit.
